summary: All 29 exact candidate patch captures reviewed. Window and fixed-control geometry fit at 960x680 and 1024x728; Results/updater/setup content is readable. Direct crops from the original fresh-workflow visible BMP confirm General settings and Readiness are present. The earlier full-frame omission interpretation was incorrect and is retracted. This establishes bounded static review only, not universal visual acceptance.
attributionCorrection: The earlier full-frame visual interpretation incorrectly reported absent General settings and Readiness, initially also misattributing the filename. Exact crops from each original fresh-workflow-960-visible.bmp contain both elements. No omission or repaint-timing defect is established by those frames.

limitations: Observed Windows Server 2022 at 96 DPI only; no representative-PC, high-DPI, multiple-monitor or physical-trackpad acceptance.
25 captures use PrintWindow and four use screen BitBlt; screen captures in this gate were taken after PrintWindow. Static captures do not establish temporal repaint quality.
Actual workspace sizes are 960x680 and 1024x728. Requested 1280x900 was bounded to 1024x728.
Keyboard assertions come from the exact native gate report and source contract, not screenshot pixels.
Screenshots show scrollable panels at their captured offsets, not every field or list row.
